extracted.name: Basil Butter
extracted.description: This delicious, easy-to-make basil-garlic butter is perfect on bread, in hot pasta, on grilled veggies, corn on the cob, or stirred into tomato sauce.
instruction_lines: Place basil, garlic, and pepper to the bowl of a food processor. Process until leaves and garlic are finely chopped.
Add butter and process until just combined. Spoon into a container with a tight-fitting lid. Refrigerate until firm.
